-- DuckDB Spatial Extension Demo: WKB Point Geometries
-- ST_AsWKB automatically converts to Well-Known Binary format
-- DuckDbOp detects and promotes WKB Points to native GeoArrow for zero-copy rendering

SELECT 
  id,
  name,
  category,
  ST_AsWKB(ST_Point(lng, lat)) as geometry,
  value
FROM (
  VALUES
    (1, 'San Francisco', 'city', -122.4194, 37.7749, 874961),
    (2, 'Los Angeles', 'city', -118.2437, 34.0522, 3979576),
    (3, 'San Diego', 'city', -117.1611, 32.7157, 1423851),
    (4, 'Sacramento', 'city', -121.4944, 38.5816, 513624),
    (5, 'San Jose', 'city', -121.8863, 37.3382, 1030119)
) AS points(id, name, category, lng, lat, value)

-- Create 50km buffer around points using ST_Buffer
-- Returns Polygon geometries as WKB

SELECT 
  id,
  name,
  ST_AsWKB(
    ST_Buffer(
      ST_Point(lng, lat), 
      50000  -- 50km buffer in meters
    )
  ) as geometry
FROM (
  VALUES
    (1, 'SF Buffer', -122.4194, 37.7749),
    (2, 'LA Buffer', -118.2437, 34.0522)
) AS points(id, name, lng, lat)

-- Calculate distances and filter by proximity
-- ST_Distance returns distance in meters

WITH cities AS (
  SELECT 
    name,
    ST_Point(lng, lat) as geom,
    lng,
    lat
  FROM (
    VALUES
      ('San Francisco', -122.4194, 37.7749),
      ('Oakland', -122.2711, 37.8044),
      ('Berkeley', -122.2728, 37.8715),
      ('San Jose', -121.8863, 37.3382)
  ) AS t(name, lng, lat)
),
centroid AS (
  SELECT ST_Point(-122.4194, 37.7749) as center_point
)
SELECT 
  c.name,
  ST_AsWKB(c.geom) as geometry,
  ROUND(ST_Distance(c.geom, ct.center_point) / 1000, 2) as distance_km
FROM cities c, centroid ct
WHERE ST_Distance(c.geom, ct.center_point) < 50000  -- Within 50km
ORDER BY distance_km
